title: your reminder to turn all your trips into photo books
hookVariations: your reminder to turn all your trips into photo books
stop letting your trips live in your camera roll
you'll forget this trip in 5 years unless you do this
visualElements: Close up of a favourite spread
executionNotes:
• Start on a real camera roll scroll (not staged) so it feels relatable
• Reveal the photo book at the beat drop
• Slow page turns, let the images breathe
• End on a close up, soft focus pull
collectionGuidance: Works with any collection size — larger collections get a longer scroll before the reveal.

title: mom, what was your dream in life?
hookVariations: mom, what was your dream in life?
asking my mom what she wanted to be before she had us
the answer made me want to document everything
visualElements: Photo book as the physical answer
executionNotes:
• Ask the question off-camera, film the natural reaction
• Cut to old photos or a photo book as she answers
• Keep it unscripted — the pause before answering is the hook
collectionGuidance: Best with a medium collection — enough photos to cut away to without repeating.

title: Making sure social media isn't my ONLY archive
hookVariations: Making sure social media isn't my ONLY archive
what happens to your memories if the app disappears?
backing up my life outside of my camera roll
executionNotes:
• ASMR box open, let the sound carry it
• Fan through the collection slowly
• End on the emotional payoff — the reason this matters
collectionGuidance: Quicker turn to books with longer expression works best for a small collection.

title: We don't want to be rich, we want THIS
hookVariations: We don't want to be rich, we want THIS
redefining what "wealthy" means for our family
this is the version of rich we're chasing
executionNotes:
• Open on an ordinary, unglamorous moment
• Voiceover reframes it as the real wealth
• Cut to the family looking through the book together
collectionGuidance: Works for any size — the point is the moment, not the volume.

title: my parents vs me at this age
hookVariations: my parents vs me at this age
comparing my life now to my parents' at 25
they'd never believe what my life looks like now
formatLayers: Format: Split comparison · Emotion: Pride, Nostalgia
executionNotes:
• Pair an old photo with a present-day recreation
• Keep the framing/angle consistent between the two
• Let the book physically hold both eras
collectionGuidance: Best with a medium-to-large collection so the comparison has range.

title: imagine showing these to your future kids
hookVariations: imagine showing these to your future kids
your future kids are going to love this
one day this is what you'll hand them
visualElements: Close up of a milestone photo
executionNotes:
• Frame it as a future memory, not a current one
• Slow, deliberate page turns
• Land on a photo that feels like a milestone
collectionGuidance: Any size works — pick your most meaningful photos regardless of volume.

title: pov: you turned 1000+ screenshots into THIS
hookVariations: pov: you turned 1000+ screenshots into THIS
1000+ screenshots, one photo book
stop hoarding screenshots, do this instead
executionNotes:
• Open on the relatable "storage full" moment
• Cut hard to the finished photo book
• Flatlay close, clean shot to end on
collectionGuidance: Great TOF hook regardless of collection size — the joke is universal.

title: imagine showing your kids how you lived in your 20s
hookVariations: imagine showing your kids how you lived in your 20s
this is going to be so funny to explain one day
documenting my 20s before I forget it
formatLayers: Format: Direct to camera · Emotion: Humour, Nostalgia
executionNotes:
• Open direct to camera, playful tone
• Flip through the book, pause on the funniest photo
• Genuine reaction laugh to close
collectionGuidance: Small collection works best — pick 8-10 genuinely funny or chaotic photos.
